title: N100-5 Raptor TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Nolan N100-5 Raptor TC-3 is engineered for seamless transitions between open-face city stops and full-face highway cruising, pairing a quick-flip chin bar with certified impact protection. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a solid 1656g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~87 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with a glove-friendly Microlock2 (Micrometric Ratchet) retention system.

product_details.description: Italian modular with N-Com communication system preinstalled.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Modular chin bar; TC3 shell offers a slightly more open fit than standard TC2; Raptor version has a distinct aggressive styling.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Nolan N100-5 Raptor TC-3: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Nolan's Modular lineup, the N100-5 Raptor TC-3 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Nolan N100-5 Raptor TC-3 represents Nolan's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Nolan N100-5 Raptor TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
